content.model_note: Exact runtime model identifier is not exposed; no guessed variant is claimed.
content.execution_method: First batch restored from its saved result. Each remaining batch uses a new independent worker request with no inherited conversation and only its own source input. Coordinator validates structure and concatenates outputs.
content.self_audit_method: Internal model review restricted to each batch own source and candidate annotations. Interrupted raw initials may be audited in a fresh isolated request. At most one complete reannotation per initial failing record.
content.recovery_note: Previous interrupted-run scratch artifacts after batch 001 were unavailable on 2026-10-21 and were regenerated; no unavailable earlier results are counted.
content.source_note: Source archive bytes, train-prefixed identities and causal history windows were checked. Official provenance declared by supplied prompts was not independently externally verified.
content.merged_source_note: Archival concatenation only; never supplied as one large annotation model request.
content.resumption_note: Preserved raw initials are never regenerated solely because a worker was interrupted; available initial outputs and per-batch runtime reports are retained.
content.raw_output_note: Complete structured authored outputs are retained before packaging, separately from execution metadata. No hidden reasoning or provider token trace is claimed.
